subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the canonical reaction-specific Slack Socket Mode investigation and require live envelope proof before any fix is attempted?
rationale: Source and shipped release inspection show the nominal handler path exists, so maintainer or live Slack proof is needed to choose between transport delivery, account filtering, authorization, or broader liveness work.

options.title: Keep reaction-specific and require proof
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical reaction report and ask for redacted current-main raw envelopes, trace logs, and account identifiers before implementation.

options.title: Fold into broader Slack Socket Mode work
options.body: Treat the reaction symptom as part of the broader Slack Socket Mode delivery or liveness cluster only if maintainers can preserve the reaction-specific evidence there.

options.title: Sponsor a live diagnostic spike
options.body: Have an owner run a live Slack multi-account proof pass to capture the first missing or dropped boundary before deciding the code fix.

recommendation.title: Keep reaction-specific and require proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical reaction report and ask for redacted current-main raw envelopes, trace logs, and account identifiers before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current connection to the Slack reaction/system-event routing code and the copied extension lines under review.
